name: Vex
description: A browser built for you — fast, private, and rearrangeable to the pixel. An Electron/Chromium desktop browser with vertical or top tabs, tab groups & workspaces, a built-in AI agent, ad/tracker blocking, Tor, split screen, sidebar app panels, Widevine DRM (Spotify/Netflix), password & 2FA autofill, E2E-encrypted sync, and a Ctrl+K command bar.

paragraphs: A fast, private, deeply customizable desktop browser built on Electron + Chromium — with a built‑in AI agent, real DRM streaming, Tor & censorship bypass, password/2FA/email‑code autofill, sidebar apps, split screen, and a UI you can literally rearrange to the pixel.

Vex is a Chromium desktop browser (via castLabs Electron, so Widevine DRM works — Netflix, Spotify, Prime, Disney+ all play). It pairs a private, ad‑free, resource‑light browsing core with an unusually deep set of built‑in tools: an AI assistant that can act on your tabs, sidebar app panels, Tor and DPI‑bypass privacy, encrypted sync, and a customize‑everything UI. Nothing here is a paid add‑on — it's all in the browser.
Windows 10/11 · 64‑bit. Install the signed build from Releases (DRM/Widevine only works in the signed build). Vex updates itself in the app.
features: 🧠 Built‑in AI agent — chat over your pages, "close all YouTube tabs" in plain English, screenshot‑to‑code, summarize/translate, content‑search everything you've read. Cloud (your own Claude worker), local (Ollama), or…
🔒 Private by default — ad + tracker blocking (network and cosmetic), fingerprint protection, DNS‑over‑HTTPS, HTTPS‑only, one‑click Tor, and a DPI/censorship‑bypass proxy — no VPN, no admin.
▶️ Real streaming — Widevine DRM playback for Netflix/Spotify/Prime/Disney+, plus codec fallbacks so short‑video sites just play.
🎨 A browser built for you — drag‑rearrange the entire toolbar & sidebar, Classic or frosted Glass UI, per‑site profiles, shareable setups, themes.
🧩 Sidebar apps — Discord, WhatsApp, Spotify, Netflix, Claude, GitHub, Roblox and any site you pin — each in its own isolated session, with unread badges.

requirements.text: Password vault — encrypted at rest with the OS keychain (DPAPI/safeStorage); offers to save on login, autofills on return.

Passkeys — Vex is a passkey provider: sites that offer "Sign in with a passkey" work in tabs and side panels, the private key stays in Vex's encrypted store (Settings › Passkeys), your Vex PIN is the user verification, and sync is off unless you turn it on.
Deploy your own Cloudflare Worker and configure its URL and client token in Settings → Cloud Services — see SELFHOSTING.md.
